headline: Mirollo-Strogatz 1990 pulse-coupled oscillators (genuine-agent): 3/3 locked clauses REPRO; concave N=100 eps=0.1 syncs 100% of seeds (median 17.0 cycles), stronger coupling faster (median 8.0 @ eps=0.2 vs 31.5 @ eps=0.05), LINEAR curve syncs 0% (concavity necessary)

verdicts.gate: P1 universal sync: concave curve (b=3), N=100, eps=0.1 syncs >= 95% of seeds
P2 coupling speeds sync: median cycles-to-sync smaller at eps=0.2 than eps=0.05
P3 concavity necessary: LINEAR curve (b=0), N=100, eps=0.1 syncs < 50% of seeds

extra.dynamics: event-driven fire / reset / SINGLE collective eps pulse in voltage / absorption (firings coalesce into one phase-locked group); concave charging curve f(phi)=(1/b)ln(1+(e^b-1)phi) with exact inverse; a firing group emits ONE eps pulse (not a domino of per-member re-kicks)
extra.scope: faithful reproduction of a published synthetic model; no real-world data; the contribution is whether the harness + discipline reproduce the Mirollo-Strogatz result (universal synchrony of concave pulse-coupled integrate-and-fire oscillators with NO finite coupling threshold, driven by curve concavity) and would catch an artifact

citations: Mirollo, R.E. & Strogatz, S.H. (1990). Synchronization of pulse-coupled biological oscillators. SIAM Journal on Applied Mathematics 50(6):1645-1662. doi:10.1137/0150098.

benchmark.note: no cross-tool baseline; faithful single-implementation reproduction graded against the Mirollo-Strogatz universal-sync result (sync fraction, cycles-to-sync monotone in eps, concavity-necessity)
